title: DeviceInfo
description: Free-text fields are length-bounded and exclude control characters (U+0000-U+001F, U+007F): a NUL cannot be stored in jsonb and used to poison the trace journal (workstation review R4). Hub (or substation asset) -> engine, published RETAINED on <root>/hub/<hub_id>/info, QoS 1, when the device connects and again if any field changes. New additive topic, 2026-09-26 (R3, OWNER DECISION) -- needs an ACL grant for og_sim to publish `hub/#` (not previously in its publish scope; tel/#, scada/#, ack/# were).

asset_class.description: D11 asset classes: a home hub (single- or dual-unit), a substation-sited battery-set asset, or a truck-mounted mobile battery (D-31 MOBILE_STORAGE; lat/lon is its current position).

units.description: 1 for a single-unit home hub, 2 for a dual-unit home hub. Always 1 for a substation asset (one PCS/battery-set unit) or a mobile unit.
